The '''Atravis systems''' were a group of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] located in the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]],<ref name="AGSWU3" /> within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> They contained the [[Atravis system/Legends|Atravis system]], which was situated on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]].<ref name="TEA" />

At some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="CotJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref> several [[Planet/Legends|planets]] within the Atravis systems were [[Atravis Sector Massacres|devastated]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in a series of attacks.<ref name="AGSWU3" /> During the massacres, the Atravis system suffered extensive civilian [[Death/Legends|casualties]].<ref name="TEA" />

By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] had seen what the Galactic Empire had left of the Atravis systems after the attacks.<ref name="CotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Atravis systems were first mentioned in [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']], a [[1995]] novel authored by [[Barbara Hambly]].<ref name="CotJ" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], placed the Atravis system, and therefore at least a part of the Atravis systems, in grid square L-19.<ref name="TEA" />
